assumptions.text: Supplies per whole expected case, fitted from the onsite workbook: saline ~2.385, diagnostic kits ~1.164, hospital beds ~0.298, rounded half-up. These reproduce every workbook row.
Planning baseline capacity (editable assumption), derived from historical ward demand: 90th percentile of weekly hospital_beds_required per ward, rounded up. Not official hospital capacity data.
Available stock is a scenario control: a percentage of the projected total demand. It is not official inventory data.
Total crews and the effect per crew are user-set scenario parameters. The dataset has no intervention records, so simulated reductions are planning scenarios, not proven causal estimates.

simulation.label: Scenario-based planning output. The per-crew effect is a user-set assumption, not a measured causal effect.
